texts.Erp:GLAccounts:00003: Direct posting is not allowed on this G/L account.

texts.Erp:Documents:00004: Document {documentNo} is not open. Reopen it before making changes.

texts.Erp:Journals:00002: Document {documentNo} is out of balance by {balance}. Each document must balance to zero before posting.
texts.Erp:Ledgers:00001: Posted ledger entries cannot be changed or deleted. Post a correcting entry instead.
texts.Erp:Items:00004: The code {code} is already in use.
texts.Erp:Documents:00006: A document with number {documentNo} already exists.
texts.Erp:Customers:00005: Customer {customerNo} has no customer posting group, so there is no receivables account to post to. Posting group: {postingGroup}.
texts.Erp:Vendors:00004: Vendor {vendorNo} has no vendor posting group, so there is no payables account to post to. Posting group: {postingGroup}.
texts.Erp:Journals:00003: A journal template named {name} already exists.
texts.Erp:Journals:00004: A batch named {name} already exists in this template.
texts.Erp:Journals:00006: Line {lineNo} of document {documentNo} has no account number.
texts.Erp:Journals:00007: Line {lineNo} of document {documentNo} posts an account against itself.
texts.Erp:Journals:00008: Line {lineNo} of document {documentNo} has no posting date.
texts.Erp:Journals:00009: A recurring line needs a recurring frequency.
texts.Erp:Journals:00010: Recurring lines are only allowed under a recurring template. Template: {templateName}.
texts.Erp:Journals:00011: {formula} is not a valid date formula. Use a form such as 1M, -7D or 1M+CM.
texts.Erp:Journals:00012: This recurring method needs allocation lines, which are not available yet.
texts.Erp:Journals:00013: A standard journal with code {code} already exists in this template.
texts.Erp:Journals:00014: {name} still has lines. Post or delete them first.
texts.Erp:Journals:00015: Posting cannot be previewed here, because this database connection does not support the transaction a preview is rolled back with.
texts.Erp:Registers:00005: Entry {entryNo} has been settled against another entry and cannot be reversed. Unapply it first.
texts.Erp:Reports:00001: An account schedule named {name} already exists.
texts.Erp:Reports:00002: A column layout named {name} already exists.
texts.Erp:Reports:00003: Row {rowNo} refers to {reference}, which is not a row of this schedule.
texts.Erp:Reports:00004: Row {rowNo} refers back to itself through its formula.
texts.Erp:Reports:00005: The formula on row {rowNo} could not be read. Use a form such as R10+R20-R30.
texts.Erp:Reports:00006: {filter} is not a valid account filter. Use a form such as 1000..1999|2100.
texts.Erp:Reports:00008: The end of the period is before its start.
texts.Erp:Modules:00002: The {module} module is switched off in this company.
texts.Erp:Modules:00003: {module} is part of the core and cannot be switched off.
texts.Erp:Modules:00004: {module} needs {dependency}, which is switched off. Switch {dependency} on first.
texts.Erp:Modules:00005: {module} is still needed by {dependants}. Switch those off first.
texts.Erp:Reports:00009: A layout named {layoutName} already exists for {reportName}.
texts.Erp:Reports:00010: {layoutType} layouts cannot be rendered yet. Use an HTML layout.
texts.Erp:Reports:00013: That report layout was not found.
texts.Erp:Reports:00014: This layout belongs to {reportName} and cannot be moved to another report.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00001: {entityName} is not a table that can be exported.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00003: Select at least one field to export.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00004: {value} is not a valid value for {fieldName}.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00005: That comparison cannot be used on {fieldName}.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00006: The export would contain {totalCount} rows, and at most {maxRowCount} can be written at once. Narrow the filter.
texts.Erp:Exporting:00007: An export template named {name} already exists for this table.
texts.Erp:Integration:00001: A web service named {serviceName} already exists.
texts.Erp:Integration:00003: {url} must use https. Plain http is only allowed for a local address.
texts.Erp:Integration:00005: Delivery {deliveryId} has already been delivered and cannot be retried.
texts.ItemWillBeDeletedMessage: This record will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
texts.PostJournalConfirmation: All lines in this batch will be posted to the ledgers. Posted entries cannot be changed.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00001: The number series '{code}' does not exist.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00002: Number series '{code}' has no open line for {date}. Add a line with a starting date on or before that date.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00003: Number series '{code}' is used up: the ending number '{endingNo}' has been reached. Add a new line to the series.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00004: You cannot type a number here: number series '{code}' does not allow manual numbers. Leave the number blank to get the next one.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00005: Number series '{code}' must be used in date order. {date} is before the last date used, {lastDateUsed}.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00006: The number cannot be incremented because it contains no digits.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00007: A number series with code '{code}' already exists.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00008: Enter a number. No number series assigns one automatically here.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00009: The number series line is not valid. {reason}
texts.Erp:Approvals:00001: User '{user}' is not in the Approval User Setup. Add them there first.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00002: No approver is defined for user '{user}' in the Approval User Setup.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00003: Nobody in the approval chain above '{user}' may approve an amount of {amount}. Raise an approval limit or mark the top approver as unlimited.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00004: An approval request for document '{documentNo}' is already pending.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00005: Document '{documentNo}' needs approval. Send an approval request; it is released when the approval is complete.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00006: This approval request is not open (status: {status}).
texts.Erp:Approvals:00007: Only the approver, '{approver}', or an approval administrator can act on this request.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00008: Document '{documentNo}' has no pending approval request to cancel.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00009: Only the sender or an approval administrator can cancel the approval request for '{documentNo}'.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00010: '{user}' has neither a substitute nor an approver to delegate to.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00011: Document '{documentNo}' is pending approval. Cancel the approval request first.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00012: The Approval User Setup contains a loop at user '{user}'.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00013: A workflow with code '{code}' already exists.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00014: User '{user}' already has an approval user setup.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00015: No enabled approval workflow applies to document '{documentNo}'. It can be released directly.
texts.Workflow:DisableBeforeEditing: Disable the workflow before changing or deleting it.
texts.DefaultNosHelp: Numbers are assigned automatically when the number is left blank.
texts.ManualNosHelp: People may type their own number instead of taking the next one.
texts.DateOrderHelp: Numbers must be assigned in date order. Required for posted invoices in some countries.
texts.NoSeriesLinesHelp: The line whose starting date is closest to the posting date is used, so a new line can start each year. Last no. used is kept by the system.
texts.SeriesWarning: The warning number has been reached. Extend the series.
texts.DocumentNumberingHelp: Which number series each kind of record draws from. Leave a field on "numbered by hand" to type numbers yourself.
texts.DocumentNoHelp: Leave blank to take the next number of the series.
texts.WorkflowsHelp: An enabled workflow makes documents of its kind need approval before they can be released or posted. Disable a workflow to change it.
texts.MinimumAmountHelp: Documents below this amount are released without approval. Zero means every document needs approval.
texts.DueDaysHelp: Days an approver has to respond. Zero means no due date.
texts.ApproverLimitTypeHelp: Approver chain: everyone up the chain until someone's limit covers the amount. Direct approver: only the sender's own approver. First qualified approver: only the first person whose limit covers it.
texts.EnableWorkflowConfirmation: Once enabled, documents of this kind will need approval before they can be released or posted. Continue?
texts.ApprovalUserSetupHelp: Who approves each person's requests, and up to what amount they may approve themselves. A request travels up this chain.
texts.SubstituteHelp: Who takes over when a request is delegated.
texts.ApprovalAdministratorHelp: May act on any approval request, whoever it is addressed to.
texts.RejectHelp: The document goes back to its sender, who can change it and ask again.
texts.DelegateHelp: Hand the request to this approver's substitute.
texts.DelegateConfirmation: The request will be handed to the approver's substitute. Continue?
texts.ApprovalAutoApproved: Within your own approval limit: the document was released.
texts.ApprovalRequestCanceled: The approval request was canceled and the document reopened.
texts.SelectADocument: Select a document to see its approval history and notes.
texts.PostDocumentConfirmation: Posting writes the ledger entries and cannot be undone. Continue?
texts.Name: Name
texts.RecurringTemplateHelp: Lines under a recurring template stay after posting and move on by their frequency, instead of being cleared.
texts.AccountScheduleRowsHelp: A row either adds up accounts, for example 1000..1999|2100, or adds up other rows by their row number, for example R10+R20-R30.
texts.JournalIsReadyToPost: The journal is ready to post.
texts.ReverseRegisterConfirmation: This writes a mirror image of every entry in register {0}. Nothing is deleted, and the correction stays on record. Continue?
texts.OnlyReversible: Only registers that can still be reversed
texts.ExcludeZeroBalances: Hide accounts with nothing on them
texts.ComparisonDateFormulaHint: For example -1Y for the same period last year
texts.ModuleDescription:Core: Companies, dimensions and number series. Everything else is addressed by these, so they are always on.
texts.ModuleDescription:Finance: Chart of accounts, general journals, posting and G/L registers. The ledger every other module writes to.
texts.ModuleDescription:Sales: Customers, sales invoices and the receivables ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Purchasing: Vendors, purchase invoices and the payables ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Inventory: Items, categories, units of measure and the item ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Reporting: Trial balance, statements, aged analyses, account schedules and report layouts.
texts.ModuleDescription:Approvals: Approval workflows, approvers and the requests waiting on them.
texts.ModuleDescription:Integration: Published web services and outbound webhooks for other systems.
texts.ModuleDescription:DataExport: Exporting any table to CSV, Excel or JSON.
texts.ModuleDescription:Chatter: Notes, activity history and follow-up tasks on any record.
texts.ModuleDescription:Kanban: Pipeline boards for documents that move through stages.
texts.ModulesDescription: Turn parts of the system on and off for this company. A module that is off disappears from the menu and its API stops answering; its data is kept and comes back untouched when you turn it on again.
texts.ModuleWillBeSwitchedOff: {0} will be switched off for this company. Its screens disappear and its API stops answering. Its data is kept, and comes back if you switch it on again.
texts.NothingNeedsAttention: Nothing needs your attention right now.
texts.NoAppsEnabled: Every module is switched off. Turn one on under Modules.
texts.ReportLayoutsDescription: Change how a report looks when it is printed. Start from the built-in layout, edit it, and make it the one this company uses.
texts.LayoutPlaceholdersHint: {{Title}}, {{CompanyName}}, {{FromDate}}, {{ToDate}}, {{PrintedOn}}; repeat with {{#Columns}}{{Header}}{{/Columns}} and {{#Rows}}{{#Cells}}{{Value}}{{/Cells}}{{/Rows}}. A row also offers {{RowClass}}, {{Indent}} and {{Cell:key}}.
texts.ExcludedFieldsHint: Separated by commas. Withheld fields cannot be read, filtered or sorted by.
texts.WebServicesHint: Nothing is readable by another system until it is published here. Callers use the same OAuth tokens as the rest of the API.
texts.SecretShownOnce: Copy this now: it is shown once and cannot be read back.
texts.TestQueued: A test notification has been queued.
texts.RetryQueued: The delivery has been queued again.
texts.WebhooksHint: Notifications are queued inside the transaction that caused the change and sent afterwards, so a slow subscriber never delays a posting.
texts.ShareTemplate: Share with everyone in this company
